author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಸಿಯೆ ಪ್ರಾಣವ ಕಾಲ ಕಾಯುತ್ತ ಕುಳಿತಿಹನು
ಹಸಿದ ಹೆಬ್ಬುಲಿಯಂತೆ ಕ್ಷಣದಿ ಎರಗುವನು
ಕುಸಿದು ಹೋಗದಿರೆಂದು ಮರಣ ನಿಶ್ಚಿತವೆಂದು
ಹಸಿವಿರಲು ಬದುಕುವೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Time sits waiting to snatch away your life;
like a hungry tiger, he pounces in an instant;
do not collapse because death is certain;
while the hunger lasts, live, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Time, Kāla, is always lying in wait and can strike as suddenly as a hungry tiger. Knowing that death is certain is no reason to give up. As long as we still have an appetite for life, we should live it fully.
